name: travel-scene-soft-filled
label: 旅行场景柔和面性图标
preamble: Simple rounded filled travel icons. Each icon shows one immediately recognizable object. Use one solid semantic main color and add a light secondary color only when it is needed to explain the object's structure.

ui_container_colors.note: These three container colors are intentionally darker than the icon's light structural color so detached light parts remain visible.

construction.grid: 24-unit keyline; live area about 80%; optical sizing
construction.angles: flat front-facing geometry with restrained 45-degree angles
construction.detail_budget: one object per icon; at most three simple color blocks
construction.fill_rule: single-color or two-color filled silhouettes; second color only for essential internal structure
construction.color_rule: one semantic scene color per icon plus its locked light tint when needed
construction.shared_parts: reuse circular dots, rounded rectangles, and matching terminal shapes
construction.perspective: flat front-facing or clearest planar view
construction.motif: soft rounded silhouettes with generous internal spacing

icon_order: basics — speech bubble with three dots
